caption:
The tool open on every developer's screen. All day. Every day.

VS Code — free, fast, and endlessly customizable.

We use it on every single project we build. Here is why we will not switch:

— Extensions for every language and framework
— Built-in Git so you never leave the editor
— Live Share to collaborate in real time
— IntelliSense autocomplete that actually saves time
— Runs on Windows, Mac, and Linux

And it is completely free.
